bagPolicy.summary: Clear tote bags smaller than 12" x 6" x 12" and handheld clutches smaller than 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. Backpacks of any size are not.
allowed: Clear tote bags smaller than 12" x 6" x 12"
Clear or non-clear handheld clutches or wristlets smaller than 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: Diaper bags that do not meet the clear bag rules
bagPolicy.note: This is the LSU Athletics clear bag policy, which LSU concert pages link for Tiger Stadium shows. Exceptions only for approved medical needs. All bags are inspected.

parking.summary: For the March 2026 Zach Bryan concert, free parking was in the Levee, Hayfield and other designated lots; prepaid reserved passes cost $40–$50 and opened at noon. These arrangements were show-specific.
